name: Memco Shared Memory
description:
Teams (of humans and agents) share knowledge so that lessons learned by one are available to all. Agents are smart but they don't know your internal practices, IP, and legacy code. Shared memory fills-in those gaps, and is orders of magnitude more effective than RAG.

Each team's workspace is private and protected by role-based access controls. Create your account for free at https://memco.ai.

Available as an MCP, cross-compatible  with agents from all vendors.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Memco Shared Memory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Memco Shared Memory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://spark.memco.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Memco Shared Memory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Memco Shared Memory provides these MCP tools: create_memory, enrich_memory, list_domains, revert_memory, search, share_feedback, and start_session.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Memco Shared Memory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Memco Shared Memory in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Memco Shared Memory MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Memco Shared Memory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Memco Shared Memory is developed by Memco AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
